utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, it's this Saturday at the community center, fixing up tools and appliances, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, exactly—Saturday from 9 to 3, and I've been telling everyone to come early if they can!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday from 9 to 3. I'll try to swing by if my errands don't run too long.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Faye, I'm so glad I ran into you! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Sunday works much better for me! I can swing by after the morning drop-off. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm glad that works! I'll have a list of needed tools ready when you come.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds familiar—is that the thing where we gather old toasters and wobbly chairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, that's the one! We're collecting anything fixable to spruce up the community center. I'm helping haul stuff, so let me know if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great! I think I have a lamp with a wonky switch somewhere. I'll dig it out—if I remember where I put it...

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah! We're organizing a community repair drive for old electronics and small appliances. Interested?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, that thing... did we decide on a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I just heard from Vik—it's set for Saturday from 9 to 3, and we're hoping to get the whole block involved.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey, Ira! I'm still trying to nail down a date for the repair drive—Noah's iffy on the 14th. What does your weekend look like?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I'm pretty open this weekend, Mara. Just picking up some supplies for Eli later—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: If you're free, how about Sunday the 15th? That gives Noah another day to check his schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, you're not gonna believe it—I've already had three people mention that repair drive to me today. You planning on bringing anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just my old drill. Figure it's worth a shot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, that drill'll be a good test for 'em. I heard Nell's thinking of hauling over her mower, so it's gonna be quite the workbench Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, so it's Saturday at the community center? And Ira's helpin' with tools — that's great. Count me in!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Glad you're in, Dane. I'll be there as long as I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Awesome, Uli! It'll be good to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive they're having this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I've heard bits and pieces about it from folks around the block—what exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, they're fixing up anything for free—old toasters, wobbly chairs, you name it. I'm bringing some tools to donate and helping out in the morning myself.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, Gus, I thought you said the repair drive was for Mrs. Gable's fence this Saturday. You're bringing tools for that, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that's the plan! I've got my hammer and a toolbox ready to go, and I can loan out anything else folks might need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So if that's settled, what's this I hear about needing a repair drive for your car too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Hana, I'm all set for Saturday. Ira's grabbing a few tools for me from the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we lock that in, Eli, can you clarify what the repair drive actually is? I want to make sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh sure, Hana. It's a community event where neighbors bring broken items and we all try to fix them together. Saturday at the community center, from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, so it's this Saturday? I'll see what I can find in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Rey! We can always use screwdrivers, wrenches, and any spare parts you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll dig through my toolbox tonight and see what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, I didn't catch the driver's face—just the van.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I still haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm just going by what I saw—that gray van with the dented panel fits the description I heard, but you're right, there's no official word yet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm still learning about the repair drive—what do you need from me, Vik?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just come Saturday from 9 to 3, and bring anything that needs fixing—early birds get the best help!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I'll bring my old toaster that's been acting up. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive. What's the time again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, sorry I'm late — what time are we setting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it's Saturday the 14th, but I'm not sure of the exact time — maybe morning?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're also questioning it, then? Good, I thought I was the only one getting sketched out by this whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sketchy? Wait, which thing? The repair drive? I keep forgetting what we're even doing with that thing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly, the repair drive. No official notice, no sign of anyone actually organizing it—just people talking about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly, and who's handling the permits if we need them? I don't want to start something and have it shut down halfway.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure about permits, but I did see a gray van with a dented side panel turn onto Maple Street about twenty minutes ago—could be the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: A gray van? That doesn't sound official either. Did you see any logos or markings on it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, have you heard anything new about that repair drive? I'm still trying to figure out what's going on.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday morning. I'll be there to help haul tools and materials.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Saturday morning? That's good to know — I was still in the dark. I'll be there too, probably lugging some supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yes, the repair drive's this Saturday! I'm keeping a list of spare parts and tools we'll need—got anything to contribute?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Cleo, there's been a change—the drive is now on Sunday at the community center instead. I hope you can still join us!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wait, Sunday? I've already got a list together for Saturday—let me check my calendar and see if I can shift things around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still trying to piece together what this repair drive actually is—can you give me a clear rundown, Quinn?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, Hana! It's a community event this Saturday at the community center where folks bring broken items and volunteers help fix them for free. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great! So it's this Saturday at the community center, and anyone can bring broken things to get fixed for free?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, I've been hearing about this repair drive from folks around the block—what exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, glad you're interested! We're all meeting this Saturday morning to fix up old Mrs. Gable's fence. I'm bringing my hammer and some extra tools—if you need anything, just holler.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a fence repair—got it! I can bring some sturdy cloth for patches, if that'd be useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So Eli, what do you think — will you be able to stop by the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I plan to. Ira's picking up some tools for me, so I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that's awesome! I'm glad you're in — maybe you can help me convince the Smiths and the Lees to join too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive? They're collecting broken stuff to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm helping out Saturday at the community center. Bringing some tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great, Leo! I'm rounding up old lamps and a squeaky bike—should keep us busy.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Well, Opal spotted a gray van on Maple Street—might be them. Any chance you saw it too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A gray van? Hmm, I think I might've seen something like that... or maybe I'm mixing it up with a delivery truck. Sorry, my memory's been fuzzy lately.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Oren—it's been a confusing week for everyone. I'll try to pin down Noah or Opal again to get a clear answer.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, Noah mentioned he might be tied up on the 14th—does that still work for you, or do you have another date in mind?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait—did Noah say he’s busy on the 14th? I thought the repair drive was set for Saturday, not a specific date. What’s the actual plan?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I was leaning toward Saturday the 14th, but Noah’s not sure yet. Do you have any other dates that could work?
